@NiagaraType
@NiagaraAction(name = "submit", flags = Flags.ASYNC)
public class BPost extends BComponent
{
  public void doSubmit() { Thread.sleep(1L); }
  public IFuture post(Action action, BValue arg, Context cx)
  {
    pool.execute(this::doSubmit);
    pool.submit(() -> doSubmit());
    pool.submit(() -> { doSubmit(); });
    pool.execute(new Invocation(this, action, arg, cx));
    return null;
  }
}
